<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Singing bhajans with a harmonium is one of the most rewarding ways to begin Indian devotional music. This guide covers posture, the drone, and your first three bhajans.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->
<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Start with the drone</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->
<!-- wp:paragraph -->
<p>Hold Sa and Pa together while you sing. Keep the bellows moving smoothly.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:heading -->
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Three bhajans to learn first</h2>
<!-- /wp:heading -->
<!-- wp:list -->
<ul class="wp-block-list"><li>Raghupati Raghav Raja Ram</li><li>Hare Krishna Hare Rama</li><li>Om Namah Shivaya</li></ul>
